title: Epic: Package Scaffold & Tooling
body:
## Overview
Initialise the `@hermetiq/buildbarn-forms` npm package within the existing monorepo, configure TypeScript, Vitest, and CI so every subsequent story has a stable foundation to build on.

## Acceptance criteria
- `packages/buildbarn-forms/` directory exists with `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, and `vitest.config.ts`
- `npm run build` and `npm test` pass from the workspace root
- GitHub Actions CI runs on every PR

title: Initialize @hermetiq/buildbarn-forms npm package
body:
## Background
Create the package directory and `package.json` inside the existing Turborepo/npm workspace.

## Tasks
- `mkdir packages/buildbarn-forms && cd packages/buildbarn-forms && npm init -y`
- Set `name: "@hermetiq/buildbarn-forms"`, `version: "0.1.0"`, `main: "dist/index.js"`, `types: "dist/index.d.ts"`
- Add to root `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (or `workspaces` in root `package.json`)

## Acceptance criteria
- `npm ls --workspaces` lists the new package
- `package.json` passes `npm publish --dry-run`

title: Configure TypeScript for the forms library
body:
## Background
Strict TypeScript is required so consumers get full type inference from proto-generated descriptors.

## Tasks
- Add `tsconfig.json` extending the repo's base config
- Set `"declaration": true`, `"declarationMap": true`, `"strict": true`
- Add `build` script: `tsc --build`
- Verify `import` from a sibling package resolves cleanly

## Acceptance criteria
- `npm run build` emits `dist/` with `.d.ts` files
- No implicit-any errors

title: Set up Vitest and initial smoke test
body:
## Background
Vitest is the workspace-standard test runner.

## Tasks
- Add `vitest` as a devDependency
- Create `vitest.config.ts` with TypeScript support
- Write a trivial passing test: `expect(true).toBe(true)`
- Add `test` script to `package.json`

## Acceptance criteria
- `npm test` passes from the package root
- Coverage report is generated

title: Add GitHub Actions CI for the new package
body:
## Background
Every PR should validate build + tests for the forms package.

## Tasks
- Add/update `.github/workflows/ci.yml` to include `packages/buildbarn-forms` in the path filter
- Ensure the matrix runs `npm run build && npm test`

## Acceptance criteria
- CI passes on a trivial PR that touches `packages/buildbarn-forms/`

title: Epic: Core ProtoFormBuilder Components
body:
## Overview
Extract and refine the `ProtoFormBuilder` React component from the main app into the new library. This epic covers the field-type renderers, form validation, proto-descriptor parsing, and a Storybook showcase.

## Acceptance criteria
- Library exports `ProtoFormBuilder`, all field renderers, and the descriptor parser
- All field types covered by Vitest unit tests
- Storybook stories render in isolation with no dependency on the main app

title: Extract ProtoFormBuilder base component
body:
## Background
The existing `ProtoFormBuilder` lives inside the main app and has implicit dependencies. It needs to be extracted as a pure library component.

## Tasks
- Copy component to `packages/buildbarn-forms/src/ProtoFormBuilder.tsx`
- Remove all app-specific imports (router, store, etc.)
- Accept descriptor and values via props
- Export from `src/index.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Component renders without importing anything from the main app
- Existing app still works after swapping to the new import path

title: Implement scalar field type renderers
body:
## Background
Proto scalars (string, int32/64, bool, float/double, bytes) each need a dedicated renderer.

## Tasks
- Create `src/renderers/StringField.tsx`
- Create `src/renderers/NumberField.tsx`
- Create `src/renderers/BoolField.tsx`
- Create `src/renderers/BytesField.tsx`
- Wire them into `ProtoFormBuilder` via a field-type dispatch map

## Acceptance criteria
- Each renderer tested with Vitest
- All proto scalar types render correctly in Storybook

title: Implement enum and nested-message field renderers
body:
## Background
Enum fields need a `<select>` bound to the proto enum descriptor. Nested messages need recursive rendering.

## Tasks
- Create `src/renderers/EnumField.tsx` — reads `enumValueDescriptor` for options
- Create `src/renderers/MessageField.tsx` — recursively renders child fields
- Handle `oneof` groups (show only the selected variant)

## Acceptance criteria
- Enum dropdown populated correctly from proto descriptor
- Nested messages expand inline
- Vitest coverage ≥ 80 % for both renderers

title: Add proto-descriptor parsing utilities
body:
## Background
The library must convert a binary `FileDescriptorSet` or JSON descriptor into a runtime field map that the renderers consume.

## Tasks
- Add `google-protobuf` (or `protobufjs`) as a peer dependency
- Implement `parseDescriptor(fd: Uint8Array | object): FieldMap`
- Expose `getFieldsForMessage(msgFqn: string, fieldMap): FieldDescriptor[]`

## Acceptance criteria
- Works with both `google-protobuf` binary format and `protobufjs` JSON format
- Unit tests cover at least 3 real-world proto definitions

title: Add form-level validation with error display
body:
## Background
Forms need to surface proto field constraints (required, range, regex) as inline validation errors.

## Tasks
- Implement `validateForm(values, descriptor): ValidationErrors`
- Render per-field error messages below each input
- Wire submit button to run validation before calling `onSubmit`

## Acceptance criteria
- Required fields block submit if empty
- Error messages match the constraint source
- Vitest snapshot tests for error states

title: Epic: Build, Publish & Consumer Integration
body:
## Overview
Prepare the package for npm publication, integrate it back into the main app, and write integration tests and developer documentation so other teams can adopt the library.

## Acceptance criteria
- Package published to private npm registry (or GitHub Packages)
- Main app uses the published version (no local symlinks in production)
- Integration tests pass in CI
- README documents installation and usage

title: Configure npm publish workflow
body:
## Background
Automate publishing to the private registry on release tags.

## Tasks
- Add `.github/workflows/publish.yml` triggered by `push: tags: ['v*']`
- Use `NPM_TOKEN` secret
- Run `npm publish --access restricted`
- Add `prepublishOnly` script that runs `build` + `test`

## Acceptance criteria
- Tagging `v0.1.0` triggers publish
- Package appears in registry within 2 minutes

title: Migrate main app to consume @hermetiq/buildbarn-forms
body:
## Background
Replace the inlined component with the published (or locally-linked) package.

## Tasks
- `npm install @hermetiq/buildbarn-forms` in the main app
- Replace all `import ... from '../components/ProtoFormBuilder'` with package imports
- Remove the old source file
- Verify app builds and all existing E2E tests still pass

## Acceptance criteria
- Zero references to the old file path
- App build succeeds
- Cypress / Playwright E2E suite green

title: Write integration tests for the forms library
body:
## Background
Unit tests cover individual renderers; integration tests verify that the full form round-trips data through submission.

## Tasks
- Use React Testing Library to mount `ProtoFormBuilder` with a real `FileDescriptorSet`
- Fill in each field, submit, and assert the serialized proto matches the expected binary
- Cover at least 2 proto message types end-to-end

## Acceptance criteria
- Tests pass in CI without any browser dependency
- Coverage for `ProtoFormBuilder` ≥ 90 %

title: Write developer README and migration guide
body:
## Background
Other Hermetiq teams need onboarding docs to adopt the library.

## Tasks
- Document: installation, peer dependencies, `ProtoFormBuilder` props API
- Include a minimal working example (copy-pasteable snippet)
- Write a migration guide from the old inlined component
- Add JSDoc comments to all exported symbols

## Acceptance criteria
- README renders correctly on npmjs.com / GitHub
- A developer unfamiliar with the library can get a working form in < 15 minutes following the guide
